newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish SOP sets Jan 27 pulp benchmark at $555.86.
newsitem.headline: Finnish SOP sets Jan 27 pulp benchmark at $555.86.

text.p: Suomen Optioporssi (SOP), a Finnish options exchange, on Monday put the value of northern bleached softwood pulp at $555.86 per tonne, down from $555.41 last week SOPI.
Information for calculation of the benchmark pulp price is supplied by more than 30 companies from 11 different countries, SOP says.
The benchmark Pulp Indicator Index (PIX) is released by SOP every Monday. In December, the PIX mean was $559.05, down from $564.54 in November, the exchange said.
SOP said last week that trading in pulp derivatives will start on February 4.
